normalization_plan.reason: The addr parameter of sendDividends only exists to feed the external .send recipient and has no independent semantics.
The value parameter of sendDividends only carries the ETH amount into the external .send call.
The addr parameter of sendDividendsWithRefBonus is the recipient of the external .send call.
The value parameter of sendDividendsWithRefBonus is part of the amount of the external .send call.
The refBonus parameter of sendDividendsWithRefBonus is added into the amount of the external .send call.
The local value of doInvest is a temporary holder of msg.value and is summarized by the doInvest state update logic.
The refBonus parameter of addRefBonus is the operand of the unchecked compound addition on storage.
The value parameter of addValue is the operand of the unchecked compound addition on storage.
The a parameter of Percent.mul exists only to be multiplied unchecked inside that helper.
The value parameter of insert is written together with the unchecked keys.length pre-increment.
The local daysAfter of getMyDividends is the multiplier of the unchecked dividend computation.
